title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go; parity fixes; version bump v1.157.0
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: We have several SDK divergences in auth retry semantics and streaming APIs between Python, TypeScript, and Go. This makes cross-language behavior unpredictable for customers and complicates our docs and examples. This PR unifies the behavior and ergonomics across SDKs and bumps SDK surface versions to v1.157.0. Summary of changes: - Consolidated auth token refresh and retry policy into a shared spec and implemented language-specific adapters. Tokens now refresh proactively 30s before expiry and retries use a single jittered backoff strategy with idempotency-aware defaults. - Streaming ergonomics improvements: standardized readable/iterable streaming helper names (stream(), stream_iter()) and added consistent cancellation and error propagation behavior across SDKs. - Parity fixes: aligned parameter names (model -> model_name), removed deprecated call args, and fixed edge-case behavior for empty-prefixed KV caching metadata. - Tests and infra: Added cross-language test vectors and local harness scripts to validate auth lifecycle and streaming reconnection flow. - Docs and examples: Updated quickstarts and migration notes for all three SDKs and bumped examples to use v1.157.0. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-3472) - [x] Unit + integration tests added/updated - [x] SDK examples updated - [x] Migration notes and changelog entry included - [x] Docs PR queued to redwood-docs Motivation: Customers using multiple SDKs reported mismatched retry behavior and surprising stream termination semantics. Unifying this reduces forward-facing surprises, simplifies troubleshooting, and lets us advertise consistent SLAs for SDKs. Testing notes: CI matrix ran all three SDK suites; added a new matrix job that simulates short-lived tokens and network blips to validate reconnection and retry semantics. Local validation harness used Docker to run Python/TS/Go clients against the perf-canary runtime cluster. Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserved for typical usage; advanced users can opt into the previous retry/resilience settings via opt-in flags for one release cycle. Migration: short migration doc included in release_notes; example patch shown to replace streaming.consume() with stream() and to use the new auth.RetryPolicy. Related PRs/refs: see ENG-3601, PM-118, and internal RFC link (internal only). Merge notes: squash-and-merge to keep history concise.
